children.name: Phyllonoma laticarpii Engl.
children.description: Phyllonoma laticarpii Engl. — a magnoliopsida species in the genus Phyllonoma.

children.name: Phyllonoma laticuspis Engl.
children.description: The native range of this species is Mexico to C. America. It is a hemiepiphytic shrub and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Phyllonoma ruscifolia Willd. ex Schult.
children.description: The native range of this species is C. America to Bolivia. It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Phyllonoma tenuidens Pittier
children.description: The native range of this species is Costa Rica to W. Panama. It is a epiphytic shrub and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Phyllonoma weberbaueri Engl.
children.description: The native range of this species is Peru to W. Bolivia. It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.
